load-balancer-no-rules-no-hourly.title: A Standard Load Balancer with no rules has no hourly charge
load-balancer-no-rules-no-hourly.body: This estimate has a load balancer with 0 rules, so there is no hourly charge; only data processed bills. Inbound NAT rules do not count as rules.

citation.quote: No, there is no hourly charge for the Standard Load Balancer when no rules are configured.
